command:
set -eu
for f in /etc/ssl/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt; do
  if [ -e "$f" ]; then ls -l "$f"; else printf 'absent %s\n' "$f"; fi
done

set -eu
for f in /etc/ssl/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt; do
  if [ -e "$f" ]; then ls -l "$f"; else printf 'absent %s\n' "$f"; fi
done

set -eu
install -d -m 700 /etc/ssl/private
umask 077
openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:4096 -sha256 -nodes -days 3650 \
  -keyout /etc/ssl/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key \
  -out /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt \
  -subj '/CN=OS Comparison Root CA' \
  -addext 'basicConstraints=critical,CA:TRUE' \
  -addext 'keyUsage=critical,keyCertSign,cRLSign' \
  -addext 'subjectKeyIdentifier=hash' \
  -addext 'authorityKeyIdentifier=keyid:always'
chmod 600 /etc/ssl/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key
chmod 644 /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt
